verses.text: In the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, the LORD made the message he spoke through Jeremiah come true. The LORD moved the heart of Cyrus king of Persia to send out an announcement all through his kingdom, and to write it down. It said:
"Cyrus king of Persia says: 'The LORD, the God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth. He has chosen me to build a temple for him in Jerusalem in Judah.
Any of his people among you may go up to Jerusalem in Judah, and may their God be with them. Let them build the temple of the LORD, the God of Israel. He is the God who lives in Jerusalem.
Wherever any of his people are left living, the people of that place must help them with silver, gold, goods, and animals, as well as gifts they choose to give for God's temple in Jerusalem.'"
Then the family leaders of Judah and Benjamin, the priests, and the Levites got ready to go up and build the LORD's temple in Jerusalem. They were everyone whose heart God had moved.
All their neighbors helped them by giving them things made of silver, gold, goods, animals, and valuable gifts, besides all the gifts people chose to give.
King Cyrus also brought out the things from the LORD's temple that Nebuchadnezzar had taken from Jerusalem and put in the temple of his gods.
Cyrus king of Persia had Mithredath the treasurer bring them out. He counted them out to Sheshbazzar, the leader of Judah.
This is the list of them: thirty gold dishes, one thousand silver dishes, twenty-nine knives,
thirty gold bowls, four hundred ten matching silver bowls, and one thousand other items.
In all there were five thousand four hundred gold and silver items. Sheshbazzar brought all of them with him when the prisoners went up from Babylon to Jerusalem.
